function.name: VarDateFromI2
function.signature: HRESULT WINAPI VarDateFromI2(short sIn, DATE* pdateOut)
function.header_comment:
/******************************************************************************
 * VarDateFromI2 (OLEAUT32.89)
 *
 * Convert a VT_I2 to a VT_DATE.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  sIn      [I] Source
 *  pdateOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
